Source: https://github.com/tim-rohwedder/fixed-length-fingerprint-extractors
Commit: 7accfca1f33b9b42bfd220e43cd5bc13b4a7fa13
Authors: T. Rohwedder et al., BIOSIG 2023.
Architecture and preprocessing: LGPL-3.0 (LICENSE).
InceptionV4.py: Remi Cadene, BSD-3-Clause (full notice in that file).
Checkpoint: author's README Google Drive link, DeepPrint_TexMinu_512/best_model.pyt.
No separate checkpoint license was supplied by the author; source license is recorded,
not a claim of additional checkpoint permissions.

Local changes to binarization.py: removed unused display/device imports; changed
constant-image min/max normalization to torch.where for tracing. Nonconstant inputs
retain the upstream formula. Upstream architecture is loaded with strict=True.
Conversion omits training-only logits/minutia map and inactive dropout. It preserves
both 256-dimensional branches, fixes the upstream batch-one texture squeeze, and
L2-normalizes their concatenation. Batch normalization stays in eval mode.

LibTorch/PyTorch: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch (BSD-3-Clause).
Torchvision (one-time conversion only): https://github.com/pytorch/vision (BSD-3-Clause).
Qt: https://www.qt.io/licensing/ (existing project dependency).

Submodule preparation: pin the commit above and apply third_party/deepprint.patch
from the main repository after initialization. The patch is tracked separately.
